# Backtest Report: Week of 2025-09-08 to 2026-09-04

## Assumptions
- Data: yfinance 1-min RTH bars; walk-forward replay through SignalRunner.detect_signals
- $1000 risk per trade, 2R target -> win +$2000, loss -$1000, scratch = R x $1000 at EOD close
- Stop+target same bar counted as loss (conservative)
- Repeat fires of same setup deduped by level (2 bars)

## Summary
- Traded signals (A+/A/B, viable stop): **4415** | 1873W 2505L 37 scratch | win rate 42.8% (of decided)
- Simulated P&L (traded all A+/A/B): **$-169257.51**
- C-grade alerts (alert-only per SPEC2): 4105 | D filtered: 51841 | tight-stop skips: 3271

## Findings & Recommendations
- A+/A win rate 38% vs B/C 43% -> grading NOT predictive this week - review PA grade criteria
- D-grade filter: filtered signals would have won 20% -> filter justified (<50%)
- 84% rule (Lesson 6 canonical 2026-07-06: solid B&R stop-out arms one re-entry on the reclaim close, ORIGINAL stop + target): 305 triggers, fired win rate 29%.
- 84% live wiring: armed per-symbol off paper stop-outs in live_scanner (2026-07-05). Requires --paper mode; signal-only runs have no stop-out feedback.
- Best setup: break_and_retest (44%) | worst: one_candle_rule (28%)
- C-grade alerts (4105, alert-only per SPEC2) would have won 38% - similar to traded grades; alert-only demotion costs little.
